title: awa97-north-american
label: Kevin Slater

won.source: A recap montage on Wednesday Night Warriors II (7 March 1997) depicts Kevin Slater winning the North American title from Remy Boudreaux with a Northern Lights Bomb; no date for the match itself survives.

note: The prior Boudreaux reign is not otherwise dated in the held record; gap-registered rather than invented.
